description_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE IN XHAMLLIK A 2+1+2 apartment is offered for sale in the area of ​​Xhamllik. The apartment is fully furnished and recently renovated, it has a total area of ​​120 m2 and has a very regular floor plan. It is organized in the corridor behind in a living room together with a very spacious kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, one of which has natural ventilation, and three balconies. The building where the apartment is located is a relatively new and well-managed building, one of the best buildings in the area, very private with only 3 entrances on the floor. The apartment is located on the 7th residential floor, not the last one. Orientation south west. Together with the apartment, 2 parking spaces are offered at an extra cost. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information, please contact me.
